messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Usual Adult Dose for Depression:
The initial dose is 150 mg orally per day in divided doses.
The dose may be increased by 50 mg orally per day every 3 to 4 days.
The maximum dose for inpatients is 600 mg/day.
The maximum dose for outpatients is 400 mg/day.
Patients should be screened for a personal or family history of bipolar disorder, mania, or hypomania prior to initiating treatment.
-Patients should be monitored for withdrawal symptoms when discontinuing therapy.
Dosage may be gradually reduced.
The reduction depends on therapeutic response.
This occurs after an adequate response has been reached.
If drowsiness develops, a major portion of the daily dose may be administered at bedtime.
If drowsiness develops, a reduction of dosage may be necessary.
-Trazodone should be taken shortly after a meal or light snack.
Use: Treatment of major depressive disorder (MDD)
Triplet: ["Trazodone", "has dose increase", "50 mg orally per day every 3 to 4 days"]

The relation 'has dose increase' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may have a specified increment in dose, as specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'dose adjustment responsibility': The entity specified by the object is responsible for making changes to the dose of the subject drug.
B. 'has strength': The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
C. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
D. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
E. 'may have added': The subject drug may have the substance specified by the object entity added to it.
